wet_room.title: Wet room / level-access shower conversion
wet_room.description: Replace a bath with a level-access shower in a wet room: former and gully laid to falls, tanked floor and shower walls, slip-resistant floor, grab rails, WC and wall-hung basin. Structure follows one council DFG level-access specification; requirement items follow Approved Document M (M4(3) where it applies) and council OT guidance.

rules.rationale: A wall-hung WC needs a concealed frame, a flush plate and a wall-hung pan. The frames cited ship a 90 mm bend with a 90/110 mm adaptor, so a separate 110 mm pan connector is not added (this differs from the original brief). Plate must match the cistern maker and series; that compatibility is a SKU check, not encoded here.
